title: Rutherford's Alpha Scattering Experiment
notes:
Rutherford's Alpha Scattering Experiment (1911)

Bombarded thin gold foil (0.00006 cm) with α-particles (He²⁺) inside a lead chamber surrounded by a ZnS fluorescent screen.

Observations: ~99% passed straight; some deflected; 1 in 20,000 bounced back.
Conclusions: Most space is empty; small dense positively charged nucleus at center.
Defects: Could not explain atomic collapse (Maxwell radiation theory) or hydrogen spectrum.
summary: Gold foil experiment, ZnS screen, nuclear model, and planetary stability defect.
